talkingPoints.text: intensive hydration, shea butter, featherlight moist shine

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Gel-oil hybrid, soft, smooth, light, melts gently onto the lips.

claimDisclaimers.text: The EVE VEGAN certification and sensitive skin irritation test are marked “scheduled” in the ENG file, but the VIE file has a visual stating “completed irritation testing on sensitive skin”; confirm the final legal status before publishing to E-com. Do not use “restores” if Vietnamese cosmetic wording rules must be followed; it can be replaced with “softens”, “nourishes”, “helps keep lips moist and smooth”.

benefits.text: BBIA Lip Oil Essence is a gel-oil lip care essence that carries over the intensive moisturizing ability of Lip Oil Balm but has a lighter texture that is more convenient for daily lip care. The 94% nourishing-ingredient formula contains 5% shea butter, cocoa butter, palm seed butter and 3 types of Hyaluronic Acid, helping to hydrate, nourish and form a thin, light moisture-locking film for dry, rough lips. The gel-oil texture melts softly on the lips, is not sticky, and leaves a clear, natural moist-shine effect. The compact, hygienic tube design is easy to carry and suitable for reapplying several times a day.

howToUse.text: Take an appropriate amount and apply directly to the lips with the tube tip. Can be used alone as a daily lip balm, applied before lip color to soften the lips, or reapplied whenever lips need more moisture.

positioning.text: Daily lip care essence that helps deeply hydrate, soften the lips and create a light, natural nourishing shine.

sellingPoints.text: 94% of the formula is nourishing ingredients; 5% shea butter + 3 types of Hyaluronic Acid; light, non-sticky gel-oil texture.

finish.text: Clear moist shine / thin and light / natural.
